**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW)**

**What I found**
- §28.1 (p0103) selects Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — outside the accepted list (NY, DE, CA, England and Wales) and, as an exclusive foreign venue, walk-away territory.
- §28.2 (p0104) already grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, so the two provisions directly conflict on forum.
- Searches for "arbitration", "Singapore", "courts", and "governed by the laws" confirm no other governing-law or arbitration provision anywhere in the document (no foreign arbitral seat); §28.3's executive-escalation step and the §28.2 interim-injunction carve-out are acceptable and untouched.

**Redline (validated, ok:true)** — one surgical replace in §28.1: "*Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction*" → "*the laws of the State of New York*", leaving §28.1 as "This Agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York."

**Element coverage (preferred)**
1. New York law governs — addressed by operation 1.
2. Exclusive jurisdiction of state and federal courts in New York County — already met verbatim in §28.2, so no additional language was added.
